title: Live from ISA Sign Expo 2025: The Future of Sign Shop Training
description: A special live episode recorded at the ISA Sign Expo 2025 in Las Vegas, featuring industry educators discussing the future of training and education in the sign industry.
keyTakeaways: The sign industry faces a significant skills gap
Formal training programs are expanding across the country
Mentorship remains crucial for hands-on learning
Technology training must keep pace with equipment advances
Investing in team education pays dividends in quality and retention
